name: v51_repro
_about: Reproduce the published v5.1 held-out numbers with today's code: the released 146-rule extractor and the base parser on the 140 v5.1 test papers, scored against the same silver gold Yaron's run used. Published (README of the extractor, Appendix F): base M3 F1 0.6865 (M1 0.610); 146 rules M3 P 0.8228 R 0.6997 F1 0.7563, 0.7525 after the object-id fix.
